run_dqn_on_bsuite: run DQN agent on a BSuite benchmark environment like deep_sea with CSV result recording
create_bsuite_environment: create a BSuite environment using load_and_record_to_csv with a specified bsuite_id and results directory
build_dqn_agent: build a DQN agent using an MLP network and environment spec from acme
wrap_environment_single_precision: wrap a BSuite environment with SinglePrecisionWrapper for single precision compatibility
run_environment_loop: run an acme EnvironmentLoop with a DQN agent for a specified number of episodes
